lessons.title: The Ball Lessons
lessons.subtitle: At the end of every chapter of {{book}}, BriBri writes a lesson in his wax-print notebook. Here are all forty, with their diagrams.
lessons.writing: {{n}} chapters written so far: the other pages arrive with the book.
lessons.partsLabel: The five parts of the journey

1.body: In Douala, on the red earth of Bonamoussadi, Tonton Fokou teaches the two brothers joy, courage and togetherness: we play together, everyone puts in their share.

2.body: In Waldorf, among snow and numbers, they find out that possession without purpose wins nothing: every pass must serve something.

3.body: Near Paris, they learn to look before receiving, to open their body, to play between the lines and to win the ball back fast.

4.body: In Barcelona: the rondo, the pausa, the third man and the superiorities. Being in the right place, making triangles.

5.body: In London, in the rain: intensity, pressing and transitions. Keeping the ball even when it burns.

lesson.original: Read the original page in French

novel.body: The saga of {{heroes}}: two brothers, a patched ball, five countries and one idea of football.

mdWhy.MD+1: The day after the match: regeneration for those who played, a high-intensity top-up for the others.
mdWhy.MD-4: Tension: small spaces, duels, changes of direction. The most intense day of the week.
mdWhy.MD-3: Duration: big spaces and long blocks, at match tempo.
mdWhy.MD-2: Speed: short, explosive efforts, transitions and finishing, full recovery between reps.
mdWhy.MD-1: Activation: low volume, speed and precision, set pieces. The legs stay fresh.
mdWhy.youth: Development session: lots of touches, play and decisions.
mdWhy.rest: No session: sleep, hydration and treatment. The body improves while it recovers.
